description: Use this when a seller wants to browse what POD Benchmark compares, or needs a category id to narrow search_products. Returns each category's id, name, parent, product count, supplier count and starting delivered price for the destination. Pass parent to list subcategories.

currency.description: Currency for every price. Defaults to the destination's own currency.

destination.description: The buyer's country, where the order ships. Product cost, shipping and duty depend on it.

offset.description: How many results to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

parent.description: Only the children of this category.

query.description: Words in the category name, such as `mugs`. Leave empty for all.

name: list_categories

id.description: The category id, to pass to search_products as `category`.

parent.description: The parent category's id; null for a top-level category.

pricedProductCount.description: How many of them have a delivered price for the destination.

productCount.description: How many products the category has.

startingPrice.description: The lowest delivered price in the category, in the response currency; null when nothing is priced.

supplierCount.description: How many suppliers have a delivered price for a product in the category.

url.description: The category's page on POD Benchmark.

currency.description: Currency for every price, such as USD, GBP or EUR.

destination.description: The buyer's country these prices are for.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

totalCount.description: How many results match in total, across every page.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: List product categories
